_comment: Attack catalogue for the Cross-Layer IDS evaluation console. Each entry is a FIXED command launched by id; the console never runs arbitrary text from the browser. Placeholders {pkg} {cmd_topic} {auth_topic} {drive_topic} {robot_ip} {iface} {rtps_port} {domain} {wire_py} are filled from console config. 'layer' is the detector layer EXPECTED to catch it, used to score the cross-layer evaluation. LAB USE ONLY: every command targets the operator's own robot on an isolated ROS_DOMAIN_ID. Single-laptop runs: robot_ip 127.0.0.1 and iface lo (DDS goes over loopback). Two-laptop runs: the robot's LAN IP and your Wi-Fi/Ethernet interface. wire_py is found automatically; set it here only to override.

attacks.label: Floor it (forward)
attacks.cmd: ros2 topic pub -r 100 {cmd_topic} geometry_msgs/msg/Twist "{linear: {x: 2.5, y: 0.0, z: 0.0}, angular: {z: 0.0}}"
attacks.desc: Publish max-speed forward 5x faster than the real controller. Infeasible step -> feasibility check.

attacks.label: Slam reverse
attacks.cmd: ros2 topic pub -r 100 {cmd_topic} geometry_msgs/msg/Twist "{linear: {x: -2.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0}, angular: {z: 0.0}}"
attacks.desc: Sudden full reverse; large velocity jump.

attacks.label: Hard spin left
attacks.desc: Max angular rate; exceeds w_max.

attacks.label: Hard spin right
attacks.desc: Max angular rate, opposite sign.

attacks.label: Freeze (deny motion)
attacks.desc: Flood zeros so the robot stops although commanded to move: consistency residual.

attacks.label: NaN garbage
attacks.desc: Non-finite values; caught by the finiteness check.

attacks.label: Out-of-range value
attacks.desc: Absurd magnitude; feasibility envelope.

attacks.label: Stealth drift (+0.10 m/s)
attacks.desc: Small feasible bias on top of the real command; only the CUSUM catches it over time.

attacks.label: Hijack steering
attacks.desc: Feasible steering bias that drives the robot off the track.

attacks.label: Crude takeover
attacks.desc: Large infeasible add-on to the real command.

attacks.label: Oscillation (shake)
attacks.cmd: bash -c 'while true; do ros2 topic pub -1 {cmd_topic} geometry_msgs/msg/Twist "{angular: {z: 3.0}}"; sleep 0.15; ros2 topic pub -1 {cmd_topic} geometry_msgs/msg/Twist "{angular: {z: -3.0}}"; sleep 0.15; done'
attacks.desc: Rapidly alternating turn commands; destabilising.

attacks.label: Node-name spoof (as pure_pursuit)
attacks.desc: Attacker takes the legitimate node's name -> network allowlist fooled; only physics + the two-writer wire check see it.

attacks.label: Topic squat (publish to /cmd_vel)
attacks.desc: Bypass the raw topic and write straight to the robot's final command topic.

attacks.label: Eavesdrop auth stream
attacks.desc: Passive subscription to the authorized commands. A confidentiality attack the IDS does NOT catch - an honest limitation to show.

attacks.label: Tamper controller speed param
attacks.desc: Change the legitimate controller's own parameter via the unauthenticated param service.

attacks.label: High-rate publisher takeover
attacks.desc: Overwhelm the wire at 500 Hz so the attacker's command always wins the race.

attacks.label: Participant flood
attacks.desc: Rapidly create/destroy participants: discovery-plane DoS. Robot keeps driving normally -> network layer only.

attacks.label: Endpoint churn
attacks.cmd: bash -c 'while true; do ros2 topic pub -1 /junk_$RANDOM std_msgs/msg/String "{data: x}"; done'
attacks.desc: Flood of short-lived writers: SEDP endpoint churn.

attacks.label: DDS port scan
attacks.desc: Scan the domain-42 RTPS UDP port range on the robot host.

attacks.label: Discovery multicast probe
attacks.desc: Probe the SPDP multicast address.

attacks.label: UDP flood at RTPS port
attacks.desc: Volumetric UDP flood at the user-data port. Needs sudo. LAB ONLY.

attacks.label: Bandwidth saturation
attacks.desc: Saturate the link with UDP traffic (needs 'iperf3 -s' running on the robot host).

attacks.label: Host recon scan
attacks.desc: Discover live hosts on the lab subnet.

attacks.label: Inject 200 ms latency
attacks.cmd: sudo tc qdisc add dev {iface} root netem delay 200ms
attacks.desc: RUN ON THE ROBOT HOST. Adds delay to its outbound traffic. Remove with the cleanup button.

attacks.label: Inject 20% packet loss
attacks.cmd: sudo tc qdisc add dev {iface} root netem loss 20%
attacks.desc: RUN ON THE ROBOT HOST. Drops 20% of outbound packets.

attacks.label: Inject jitter
attacks.cmd: sudo tc qdisc add dev {iface} root netem delay 100ms 50ms
attacks.desc: RUN ON THE ROBOT HOST. 100 ms +/- 50 ms jitter.

attacks.label: Sudden stop (zero-vel flood)
attacks.desc: Deny motion while the controller still commands forward travel; consistency residual grows.

attacks.label: Overspeed ramp
attacks.desc: High infeasible speed added to the authorized command; feasibility envelope.

attacks.label: Lateral spin bias
attacks.desc: Feasible but unauthorized turn bias; motion diverges from the authorized prediction.

attacks.label: Square-wave throttle
attacks.desc: Alternating speed steps; acceleration-infeasible transitions.

attacks.label: Micro drift (+0.05 m/s)
attacks.desc: Very small persistent bias near the stealth floor; CUSUM accumulates slowly.

attacks.label: Reverse creep
attacks.desc: Slow reverse while forward is commanded; sign mismatch in the residual.

attacks.label: Jerk steering
attacks.desc: Aggressive steering bias driving hard off-track; large peak deviation.

attacks.label: Infinity value
attacks.desc: Non-finite command; finiteness check in the feasibility test.

attacks.label: Low-rate injection
attacks.desc: Injection slower than the controller; interleaves rather than dominates.

attacks.label: Spoof as patrol_controller
attacks.desc: Allowlisted name reused; network layer fooled, physics layer catches the motion.

attacks.label: Inject on authorized topic
attacks.desc: Publish onto the authorized reference itself; tests the trust boundary on cmd_vel_auth.

attacks.label: Namespace squat
attacks.desc: Publish on a look-alike namespaced topic; extra publisher appears in the graph.

attacks.label: Tamper lookahead param
attacks.desc: Destabilise the legitimate controller through its unauthenticated param service.

attacks.label: Enumerate services
attacks.desc: Reconnaissance of exposed services; passive, not a motion attack.

attacks.label: Duplicate takeover (2 writers)
attacks.desc: Second writer on the command topic; multi-writer condition on the wire.

attacks.label: SPDP participant spam
attacks.desc: Rapid participant churn; discovery-plane load, robot keeps driving normally.

attacks.label: SEDP endpoint churn
attacks.cmd: bash -c 'while true; do ros2 topic pub -1 /churn_$RANDOM std_msgs/msg/String "{data: x}"; done'
attacks.desc: Flood of short-lived writers; endpoint announcement churn.

attacks.label: Domain port sweep
attacks.desc: Scan the base RTPS port band on the robot host.

attacks.label: QoS-mismatch probe
attacks.desc: Join the topic with a mismatched QoS profile; new endpoint on the wire.

attacks.label: ARP flood
attacks.desc: Volumetric flood from spoofed sources. Needs sudo. LAB ONLY.

attacks.label: Fragmented UDP
attacks.desc: Oversized fragmented datagrams at the RTPS port. Needs sudo. LAB ONLY.

attacks.label: Bandwidth burst
attacks.desc: Short high-rate UDP burst (needs iperf3 -s on the robot host).

attacks.label: Rate-limit egress
attacks.cmd: sudo tc qdisc add dev {iface} root tbf rate 1mbit burst 32kbit latency 400ms
attacks.desc: RUN ON THE ROBOT HOST. Throttle outbound bandwidth; degrades the control link.

attacks.label: Packet reordering
attacks.cmd: sudo tc qdisc add dev {iface} root netem delay 50ms reorder 25% 50%
attacks.desc: RUN ON THE ROBOT HOST. Reorder outbound packets; stresses DDS reliability.

tools.label: Wire capture (tshark metrics)
tools.desc: Per-second DDS metrics (packets, user data, endpoint announcements) and the multi-writer / discovery-flood / churn alerts. Feeds the DDS traffic chart. Needs packet-capture permission (wireshark group).

tools.label: Open Wireshark (DDS, ROS2-IDS view)
tools.cmd: wireshark -C ROS2-IDS -i {iface} -k -f "udp portrange 17900-18149" -Y "ros2ids && ros2ids.kind != \"SIM\" && ros2ids.kind != \"RELIABILITY\" && ros2ids.kind != \"VIZ\""
tools.desc: Wireshark on this domain's DDS ports only, ROS2-IDS profile (readable kind/topic/writer/summary columns, decoded commands). Install the profile first (ros2_ids_wireshark/install.sh). Best started before the bench.

tools.label: iperf3 server (on robot host)
tools.desc: RUN ON THE ROBOT HOST so the saturation attack has a target.

tools.label: Latency baseline (ping)
tools.desc: Round-trip time to the robot host.

tools.label: Clear tc netem (robot host)
tools.cmd: sudo tc qdisc del dev {iface} root
